name: Random Classic Heroic and Mythic stay listed for an under-geared level 60 player; the join still enforces the gear requirements
contract: The Ascension Dungeon Finder dropdown lists a random dungeon only when the server does not lock it (Ascension_PVE.lua InitializeDropdown); the live client greys Random Classic Dungeon Mythic (2258) with its item level and PvE Power reason (C_LFG.CanUseRandomLFD). The server therefore leaves Random Classic Dungeon Heroic (1258) and Mythic (2258) out of an under-geared level 60 player's lock list and refuses only the join. A level 50 player is still locked out of 2258 by level.
